title: The monkey and the mango tree
text:
Once there was a monkey called Koko who lived beside a river. In the middle of the river grew a huge mango tree on a small island. It was full of ripe, golden fruit. Koko wanted those mangoes more than anything.

He tried to swim across, but the current was too strong. He tried to jump from rock to rock, but the rocks were too far apart. Koko sat down and sulked.

A little turtle, who had been watching, swam up. "Why are you so sad?" she asked. Koko pointed at the tree. "I cannot reach it."

"I can carry you," said the turtle. "But you must hold on tight and not move around." Koko climbed onto her shell. Slowly, the turtle swam across the river.

On the island, Koko picked the sweetest mangoes. He gave the first one to the turtle. "Thank you for your kindness," he said. The turtle smiled and ate it happily.

From that day, Koko never forgot that asking for help is not weak. It is wise.
